prompt: The client wants to know where to invest for growth. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Stores are the larger channel today, at $72M
options.feedback: True, but store sales are shrinking. All the growth is online.

options.text: Both channels contributed growth, online the most
options.feedback: Store sales fell every year, from 80 to 72.
The chart shows revenue, not profit. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.
Right. Online rose 43 (20 to 63) while stores fell 8 (80 to 72); total rose from 100 to 135.
